component.name: GLViewer
component.summary: View system journal, local and remote log files

description.p: GLViewer is a fast log viewer for the systemd journal, local log files and logs on remote machines reached via SSH.

ul.li: Browse the systemd journal by boot, unit, priority and time range, and follow it live
Open plain or compressed log files with automatic encoding detection
Connect to remote hosts via SSH, browse /var/log and read the remote journal
Search and filter by text, regular expression, severity and time
Compare logs side by side with scrolling synchronized by timestamp
Show timestamps normalized to a time zone of your choice

screenshot.caption: Two log files side by side, scrolled in sync by timestamp

description.p: Flatpak bundle attached to releases. AI-generated code disclosed in the README.
